about.intro_p1: XINCAIJET Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the R&D, production and sales of industrial-grade UV printing equipment. Founded in 2006 with 20 years of industry experience, headquartered in Shanghai with a modern production base in Nantong, Jiangsu.
about.intro_p2: We are committed to providing high-quality, high-efficiency UV printing solutions for global clients. Our products cover UV flatbed printers, DTF printers, crystal label printers and other series, widely used in advertising signage, home décor, industrial customization, crafts and gifts.
about.intro_p3: The company adheres to the philosophy of 'innovation-driven, quality-first', owning multiple core patent technologies. Our products are exported to over 80 countries and regions, earning consistent praise from domestic and international clients.
tech.detail.1_desc: Not simple parts assembly — independently designed complete machine body architecture, deeply integrated with industry-proven control systems. From frame to core transmission components, all are independently designed and molded, ensuring structural integrity and stable operation. Unlike generic assembled machines on the market, every unit undergoes structural mechanics optimization verification.
tech.detail.2_desc: Selecting industry-proven electronic control solutions without blindly stacking configurations, focusing on specialized optimization of body structure, frame and transmission system. The stable electronic control platform paired with deeply tuned mechanical systems ensures outstanding print precision and stability even under prolonged high-intensity operation.
tech.detail.3_desc: Unlike generic assembled machines, we customize body structures for different process scenarios including UV flatbed printing and UV DTF roll printing. From media height adaptation on flatbed machines to the paper feed system on roll machines, every design element serves specific production processes, adapting to flexible production needs across multiple materials and specifications.
tech.detail.4_desc: The frame uses high-strength steel processed as a single piece, with the transmission system employing high-precision guide rails and silent synchronous belts, specially tuned to ensure smooth, vibration-free movement. Excellent precision retention during long continuous printing runs, with wear-resistant critical components that effectively reduce total lifecycle maintenance costs.
tech.detail.5_desc: As a source factory, every unit undergoes a complete assembly and debugging process before shipping. From body structure calibration to printhead alignment and color linearization, each step is rigorously controlled. Delivered in optimal condition, reducing client-side installation and debugging time so you can start production immediately upon powering on.
tech.detail.6_desc: The entire machine, from structural design to component selection, is built to industrial-grade durability standards. Critical components use branded supplier custom parts, the body surface undergoes anti-rust and anti-corrosion treatment, and electrical wiring follows standardized routing. Combining equipment durability with process adaptability, confidently handling the challenges of mass production and diverse orders.
app.detail.1_desc: Indoor/outdoor billboards, display signage, directional signs, lightbox films, exhibition stand graphics and more. UV printing delivers vibrant colors, strong weather resistance and excellent adhesion, meeting the dual demands of quality and efficiency in the advertising industry.
app.detail.2_desc: Personalized printing on digital product shells, gift surfaces, packaging boxes and more. Supports exquisite pattern customization on phone cases, tablet cases, power banks, USB drives and various digital accessories and craft gifts.
app.detail.3_desc: Crystal labels and UV transfer stickers mass production solution. Integrated printing, laminating and curing, compatible with TPU film, 3D, hot stamping and more, ideal for label and sticker batch production.
app.detail.4_desc: Home decorative paintings, cabinet door panels, slate, ceramic tiles, glass art, furniture surface decoration and more. Making every space full of personality and creativity.
app.detail.5_desc: LOGO/label customization on hardware parts, plastic parts and electronic components. High-precision printing ensures clear text and strong adhesion, meeting industrial-grade quality requirements.
app.detail.6_desc: Pattern printing on luggage fabrics, footwear materials, leather, textiles and more. Suitable for exquisite pattern customization on various flexible material surfaces, with durable colors and soft hand feel.
app.detail.7_desc: Supporting cross-border e-commerce small-batch, multi-variety personalized custom product printing. Fast response, flexible production, perfectly matching the customization needs of cross-border e-commerce sellers.
app.detail.8_desc: Corporate business gifts and cultural & creative peripheral product customization. Including custom gift boxes, notebooks, thermos cups, badges, fridge magnets and more corporate gifts and cultural creative products.
news.4_desc: The flagship 3050 UV Flatbed Printer receives a major upgrade with new automatic loading/unloading system and visual positioning, significantly improving production efficiency.

pd.3050.title: 3050 UV Flatbed Printer
pd.3050.tagline: 3000×5000mm ultra-large print area, industrial Ricoh printhead, supporting direct printing on glass, acrylic, wood, metal and other materials, meeting the production needs of large-scale advertising and decorative panels.
pd.3050.overview_desc: The 3050 UV Flatbed Printer features industrial Ricoh GH2220 printheads with UV LED curing technology for instant drying. The intelligent control system integrates various production parameters for convenience, supports multiple printhead configurations, and includes anti-collision resume printing for higher yield rates.
pd.3050.hl1_desc: Ultra-large hard anodized suction platform, suitable for most large-format flat media printing
pd.3050.hl2_desc: High-density nozzles, precise ink droplets, up to 1440dpi resolution, delicate print quality
pd.3050.hl3_desc: Cold light instant curing, print-and-dry, no material surface damage, 30% energy reduction
pd.3050.f1_desc: 3000×5000mm ultra-large print zone with hard anodized suction platform, meeting the needs of large billboards, decorative panels, architectural models and other large-format printing. Y-axis PVC belt drive, economical and easy to maintain.
pd.3050.f2_desc: Featuring Ricoh GH2220 industrial printheads with high nozzle density and precise ink droplets. Supports CMYK+W+V multi-color scheme, completing white base, color printing, and varnish coating in one pass for embossed and glossy effects.
pd.3050.f3_desc: Equipped with intelligent print control software with integrated control panel for centralized production parameter settings. Supports automatic color calibration, printhead compensation, automatic layout and remote print status monitoring.
